newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA OFFERS 10 DISCOUNT T-BILL ISSUES FEB 24-28.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA OFFERS 10 DISCOUNT T-BILL ISSUES FEB 24-28.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will
offer 10 issues of discount T-bills with no par value or
minimum acceptable price set in advance at auctions this week,
the central bank said.
Half of the issues have a maturity of one week and the rest
have a four-week maturity. Auction dates and issue dates for
each issue overlap.

The ministry has issued short-term treasury bills each day
since January 20 to drain excessive banks' liquidity in line
with preparations for the introduction of a restrictive
monetary regime, the currency board system.
As a result of the ministry's decisison the central bank
has suspended its daily open market operations through daily
revrepo auctions with repurchase of over two days.
The decisions were related to preparing the banking system
for the introduction of a currency board system proposed by the
International Monetary Fund under which central bank open
market operations would be curbed.
